verses.en: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.pt: Ouvi isto, ó sacerdotes, e escutai, ó casa de Israel, e dai ouvidos, ó casa do rei; porque contra vós se dirige este juízo; pois que vos tornastes um laço para Mizpá, e uma rede estendida sobre o Tabor.
verses.en_web: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to this, O priests; give attention, O Israel, and you, family of the king; for you are to be judged; you have been a deceit at Mizpah and a net stretched out on Tabor.

verses.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
verses.pt: Os revoltosos se aprofundaram na corrupção; mas eu os castigarei a todos eles.
verses.en_web: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I discipline all of them.
verses.en_bbe: They have gone deep in the evil ways of Shittim, but I am the judge of all.

verses.en: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.
verses.pt: Eu conheço a Efraim, e Israel não se me esconde; porque agora te tens prostituído, ó Efraim, e Israel se contaminou.
verses.en_web: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.
verses.en_bbe: I have knowledge of Ephraim, and Israel is not secret from me; for now, O Ephraim, you have been false to me, Israel has become unclean.

verses.en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
verses.pt: As suas ações não lhes permitem voltar para o seu Deus; porque o espírito da prostituição está no meio deles, e não conhecem ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God; for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Their works will not let them come back to their God, for a false spirit is in them and they have no knowledge of the Lord.

verses.en: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
verses.pt: A soberba de Israel testifica contra eles; e Israel e Efraim cairão pela sua iniqüidade, e Judá cairá juntamente com eles.
verses.en_web: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.
verses.en_bbe: And the pride of Israel gives an answer to his face; and Ephraim will have a fall through his sins, and the fall of Judah will be the same as theirs.

verses.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
verses.pt: Eles irão com os seus rebanhos e com as suas manadas, para buscarem ao Senhor, mas não o acharão; ele se retirou deles.
verses.en_web: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Yahweh; but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.
verses.en_bbe: They will go, with their flocks and their herds, in search of the Lord, but they will not see him; he has taken himself out of their view.

verses.en: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
verses.pt: Aleivosamente se houveram contra o Senhor, porque geraram filhos estranhos; agora a festa da lua nova os consumirá, juntamente com as suas porções.
verses.en_web: They are unfaithful to Yahweh; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.
verses.en_bbe: They have been false to the Lord; they have given birth to strange children; now the new moon will make them waste with their fields.

verses.en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven, after thee, O Benjamin.
verses.pt: Tocai a corneta em Gibeá, a trombeta em Ramá; soltai o alarma em Bete-Áven; após ti, ó Benjamim.
verses.en_web: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!
verses.en_bbe: Let the horn be sounded in Gibeah and in Ramah; give a loud cry in Beth-aven, They are after you, O Benjamin.

verses.en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
verses.pt: Efraim será para assolação no dia do castigo: entre as tribos de Israel declaro o que é certo.
verses.en_web: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.
verses.en_bbe: Ephraim will become a waste in the day of punishment; I have given knowledge among the tribes of Israel of what is certain.

verses.en: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
verses.pt: Os príncipes de Judá são como os que removem os marcos; derramarei, pois, o meu furor sobre eles como água.
verses.en_web: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.
verses.en_bbe: The rulers of Judah are like those who take away a landmark; I will let loose my wrath on them like flowing water.

verses.en: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
verses.pt: Efraim está oprimido e quebrantado no juízo, porque foi do seu agrado andar após a vaidade.
verses.en_web: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment; Because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
verses.en_bbe: Ephraim is troubled; he is crushed by his judges, because he took pleasure in walking after deceit.

verses.en: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
verses.pt: Portanto para Efraim serei como a traça e para a casa de Judá como a podridão.
verses.en_web: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.
verses.en_bbe: And so to Ephraim I am like a wasting insect, and a destruction to the children of Judah.

verses.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
verses.pt: Quando Efraim viu a sua enfermidade, e Judá a sua chaga, recorreu Efraim à Assíria e enviou ao rei Jarebe; mas ele não pode curar-vos, nem sarar a vossa chaga.
verses.en_web: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, Then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to king Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.
verses.en_bbe: When Ephraim saw his disease and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria and sent to the great king; but he is not able to make you well or give you help for your wound.

verses.en: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
verses.pt: Pois para Efraim serei como um leão, e como um leão novo para a casa de Judá; eu, sim eu despedaçarei, e ir-me-ei embora; arrebatarei, e não haverá quem livre.
verses.en_web: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.
verses.en_bbe: For I will be to Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the children of Judah; I, even I, will give him wounds and go away; I will take him away, and there will be no helper.

verses.en: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
verses.pt: Irei, e voltarei para o meu lugar, até que se reconheçam culpados e busquem a minha face; estando eles aflitos, ansiosamente me buscarão.
verses.en_web: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”
verses.en_bbe: I will go back to my place till they are made waste; in their trouble they will go after me early and will make search for me.
